articles.title: Our CI Failed 40% of the Time and the Code Was Fine: A Flaky Test
articles.excerpt: "Just re-run it." If you've ever typed those words into a Slack thread, this story is for you. It was 4:47 PM on a Thursday. Priya, a backend engineer at a 12-person B2B SaaS startup, pushed a one-lin…
articles.body: "Just re-run it." Four words that quietly destroyed the trust of an entire engineering team. If you've ever typed those words into a Slack thread, this story is for you. A Red Build Nobody Believed It was 4:47 PM on a Thursday. Priya, a backend engineer at a 12-person B2B SaaS startup, pushed a one-line fix for a typo in an email template. The pipeline went red. She didn't read the logs. She didn't even open the failed job. She clicked Re-run all jobs , grabbed a coffee, and came back to a green build. Nothing in the code had changed. The build had simply decided to pass the second time. That moment, repeated dozens of times a week, is what we'll dissect in this case study.

articles.title: Lokutor Is Now a LiveKit Agents Plugin
articles.excerpt: Lokutor is now a plugin for LiveKit Agents. livekit-plugins-lokutor was merged into livekit/agents on 12 November 2026, and it gives any LiveKit agent our speech recognition and our voices. LiveKit is…
articles.body: Lokutor is now a plugin for LiveKit Agents . livekit-plugins-lokutor was merged into livekit/agents on 12 November 2026, and it gives any LiveKit agent our speech recognition and our voices. What is LiveKit Agents? LiveKit is open-source infrastructure for realtime audio and video. LiveKit Agents is its Python framework for voice agents that join a room or a phone call. The framework runs the conversation: the room, turn-taking, interruptions and the language model. Plugins supply the speech in and out. What the plugin adds lokutor.STT : Conv 2.0, our speech recognition model. It streams interim and final transcripts as the user speaks, written out with punctuation, casing and digits. If you don't set the language, it is detected. lokutor.TTS : Versa 2.0, our voice model.

articles.body: You want a chatbot that answers questions about a library's documentation. The hard part is rarely the LLM. It is getting the docs out of HTML and into clean, well-cut chunks: no navigation menus, no cookie banners, no footers repeated on every page, and chunks that keep track of which section they came from. This walkthrough takes the FastAPI documentation, converts it to Markdown, cuts it into ~400-token chunks with their heading path, and loads them into a local vector store. Total code: about 25 lines of Python. What you need Python 3.9+ A free Apify account (the free plan's monthly credit covers this tutorial many times over) pip install apify-client chromadb We use the Web Page to Markdown Actor for the conversion. Disclosure: I built it.

articles.title: Rujira FIN Exploit: CCL Skew Math Costs $200K
articles.excerpt: Originally published at Rujira FIN Exploit: CCL Skew Math Costs $200K On the evening of Tuesday, 10 November 2026, someone found a way to make money from the liquidity providers on Rujira Trade, the o…
articles.body: Originally published at Rujira FIN Exploit: CCL Skew Math Costs $200K On the evening of Tuesday, 10 November 2026 , someone found a way to make money from the liquidity providers on Rujira Trade , the order book that runs as a CosmWasm application on THORChain . Rujira says an attacker "exploited an issue with the CCL skew calculations", which let them unbalance existing BTC/USDC Custom Concentrated Liquidity (CCL) positions. The estimated loss is about $200,000 : roughly $175,000 from positions run by Liquidy Finance and roughly $25,000 from other users. Rujira has said all losses will be reimbursed. THORChain node operators halted the CosmWasm app layer, and the team is preparing an upgraded FIN contract that removes the skew parameter entirely .

articles.title: This supernova impostor baffled astronomers for 15 years — until they found a hidden black hole feeding on an unstable star
articles.excerpt: A hidden black hole or neutron star companion to an unstable massive star is causing the system to erupt in light that mimics a supernova explosion.
articles.body: A cosmic imposter that has faked being a supernova 27 times and counting is actually a hot, luminous, and decidedly unstable star that is being fed on by a vampiric black hole or neutron star, NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory has discovered. When a massive star reaches the end of the road and runs out of nuclear fuel to power fusion reactions in its core, the star is destroyed in a supernova explosion. That’s what astronomers thought they had found on 11 January 2012, when they observed what appeared to be a supernova on the outskirts of the spiral galaxy NGC 4559, which is about 25 million light-years away in the constellation Coma Berenices. Yet when the light of the 'supernova' faded, the star was still there, only to continue bursting into light every 113 days.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 12, 2014: European Philae probe lands on Comet 67P, bounced twice and then got lost for nearly 2 years
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 12, 2014, a European spacecraft named Philae landed on Comet 67P, then bounced twice and got lost. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 12, 2014, a European spacecraft named Philae landed on Comet 67P . To say it was a bumpy landing would be an understatement. The European Space Agency's Philae lander separated from an orbiter called Rosetta ahead of its historic landing in 2014. It was supposed to use harpoons to secure itself on to the surface of Comet 67P, but the harpoons never fired. When it touched down, it immediately bounced back up into space . The first bounce brought Philae half a mile above the comet's surface before gravity brought it back down. Philae was missing for almost two years before scientists found it . Images from Rosetta showed Philae stuck in a dark crevice on top of the rubber duck-shaped comet.

articles.body: Representatives from Nvidia told Illinois representative Bill Foster that it would be technically possible to implement the anti-smuggling measures called for in the Chip Security Act, Foster told MIT Technology Review in an interview on Thursday, even while an industry group claimed they were “potentially infeasible.” Foster, a Democrat who serves on the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, is a cosponsor of the act, which would introduce geotracking requirements to verify the location of advanced AI chips in order to prevent their smuggling to China.

articles.body: 4 Min Read I Am Artemis Katie Spicer For Katie Spicer, embracing opportunity and challenge has led to giant leaps during her time at NASA. Now as the NASA lander integration lead for Blue Origin’s Blue Moon Mark 2 lander, one of the commercially provided human landing systems for NASA’s Artemis program, Spicer will have her handprint on history. NASA’s Katie Spicer stands in front of the crew cabin prototype for Blue Origin’s Blue Moon Mark 2 lunar lander. The lander is one of two commercial human landing systems that will help safely ferry astronauts from lunar orbit to the Moon’s surface and back for the agency’s crewed Artemis missions in 2028.
